title: Fresh yellow curb lines marking the kill zone on Elm Street

tellings.quote: Did you know that there were three yellow painted lines right on the side of the curb where the shot in in conjunction where all the shots took place in the in the kill zone and they were painted the night before cuz Beverly Oliver was standing on one.

plain: In November 1963 President John F. Kennedy was shot in Dealey Plaza in Dallas, on Elm Street, an event also captured in a famous home movie called the Zapruder film. Dan Sheehan, speaking on Jesse Michels's podcast, says three yellow lines had been painted on the curb right where the shots happened, and that they were painted the night before, because a witness named Beverly Oliver was standing on one. If true, it would suggest the spot was marked out in advance.
